sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the DIRECT_STATIC requirement: it targets ships, requires a single boolean applicability value, conditionally traverses hasProtectedItem only when exposure is true, and enforces both permitted protected-item categories and associated ice/snow removal or prevention means on each linked protected item. It does not incorrectly require every category to exist.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the six UNION branches that require escape-route, muster-station, embarkation-area, survival-craft, launching-appliance, and survival-craft-access categories to be globally represented. The requirement is universal over protected items that exist; it does not require existence of every category or even any protected item when the applicability condition is true. Retain a conditional per-item check reached through hasProtectedItem, requiring the declared protectedItemCategory and hasIceSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans relationships on each actual protectedItem. Also do not describe the rule as requiring “one” category unless the verified contract explicitly requires cardinality one; the current query rejects missing categories and invalid values but permits multiple permitted category values.

The candidate faithfully encodes the DIRECT_STATIC requirement: it targets ships, requires a single boolean applicability value, conditionally traverses hasProtectedItem only when exposure is true, and enforces both permitted protected-item categories and associated ice/snow removal or prevention means on each linked protected item. It does not incorrectly require every category to exist.
